title: Carrot Cake
hookLine: British-inspired carrot cake with 12 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Prep & Mix: Carrot Cake
steps.instructionTemplate: For the carrot cake, preheat the oven to 160C/325F/Gas 3. Grease and line a 26cm/10in springform cake tin. Line your baking pan with parchment paper or grease lightly, and make sure {m52897_1}, {m52897_2}, {m52897_3}, and {m52897_4} are measured and at room temperature so they blend smoothly.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure vegetable oil first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Build Flavor: Carrot Cake
steps.instructionTemplate: Mix all of the ingredients for the carrot cake, except the carrots and walnuts, together in a bowl until well combined. Stir in the carrots and walnuts. Incorporate {m52897_5}, {m52897_6}, {m52897_7}, {m52897_8}, {m52897_9}, {m52897_10}, {m52897_11}, and {m52897_12} smoothly until evenly distributed.

steps.title: Shape & Layer: Carrot Cake
steps.instructionTemplate: Spoon the mixture into the cake tin and bake for 1 hour 15 minutes, or until a skewer inserted into the middle comes out clean. Remove the cake from the oven and set aside to cool for 10 minutes, then carefully remove the cake from the tin and set aside to cool completely on a cooling rack.

steps.title: Bake / Chill: Carrot Cake
steps.instructionTemplate: Meanwhile, for the icing, beat the cream cheese, caster sugar and butter together in a bowl until fluffy. Spread the icing over the top of the cake with a palette knife.
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Wait until the sponge feels cool to the touch before frosting so your glaze or cream stays thick and glossy.

ugcQuotes.quote: Followed the scaled metric steps—came out flawless in 45 mins!
